title: Resource-complexity peer patterns and attributed-INSERT staging
mode: deep/broad research, local source audit, and implementation follow-up
scope: Audit the local attributed-INSERT staging and commit-order path
Implement and validate the bounded attributed-INSERT staging slice
Update the readiness plan and implementation receipt

sources.observation: Reports quadratic block-handle growth in large dwg_add sessions.

Proposes fixes for exact-size handle vector growth, middle insertion into an ordered reference index, and repeated reference-resolution sweeps caused by a dirty flag. Peer-reported measurements and corpus checks are not independently reproduced here.
A malformed R13+ Classes count caused repeated reallocations; the merged peer fix bounds count by available section size.
Adds section-size-derived class-count guard before class-array growth.
Provides one-entity-at-a-time ASCII DXF modelspace iteration for very large files, with no structural checks and limited foreign-entity resource transfer.
Reports high CPU and OOM while rendering a dense HATCH; this is consumer/render work, not evidence of parser complexity.

evidence: stagePendingAttribute scans staged pending/orphan attribute vectors for duplicates and calls reserve(size()+1) for each appended child.
stagePendingInsert scans a growing temporary handle vector while validating child-first orphan adoption.
prepareInsertCommit searches the staged attribute vector for each declared handle and preserves declaration order.
Modern-profile expected-handle validation scans INSERT attribHandles once per child.
dwgReaderDetail already provides checked geometric vector-capacity planning/reservation helpers for POLYLINE staging.
localAudit.complexity: Nested duplicate/expected-reference scans and commit-time lookup are O(N^2) in attribute count. Exact-capacity vector reallocation amplification is implementation-dependent.
localAudit.safetyCrosscheck: The local R13-R2000 Classes loop is byte-section-bounded and parses fixed bit fields plus variable-text prefixes. The R2004+ path bounds the declared class count, reserves containers before iteration, and validates cursor spans. No equivalent local Classes DoS was established.

planImpact.implementationSummary: Added a deterministic map from staged ATTRIB handle to owner/ordinal, sorted unique modern declared-reference projections, aggregate MaxDwgReadObjectCount admission for both index populations, and geometric growth for pending/orphan vectors and owner maps. Removed repeated linear duplicate/expected-handle scans, commit-time find_if, quadratic completion checks, and the cross-attribute vector duplicate audit. Preserved declared callback order, child-first adoption, rollback, callback transactionality, and R13-R2000 first/last endpoint behavior.
planImpact.nextImplementation: PAR-140 / 7N.4 HATCH and MPOLYGON associative boundary-reference retention, as the next local-ready codec slice; continue despite workspace Git metadata being read-only.
planImpact.largeFileStrategyBoundary: Do not replace complete-document parsing/export with ezdxf's modelspace-only iterator. Any future streaming API is a separate restricted contract with its own structure/resource/identity tests.

method.limitations: The 257-ATTRIB generated parent-first/child-first stress control exercises the production staging state machine directly; no separate 257-ATTRIB serialized whole-file fixture was added. The existing full in-memory DWG local-roundtrip target ran and failed three MPOLYGON/HATCH assertions outside the changed code paths; no INSERT/ATTRIB assertion was reported. No timing threshold or complete test suite was run. The worktree was already broadly dirty and remains user-owned.
